name: Project
description: Project master. Parent of BOQ. Seeded for WhatsApp daily-log Correct linking.

projectCode.description: Short project code used in forms (e.g. PRJ-DEMO).

name: Assumption
description: Assumption

unitValue.title: Unit Value
unitValue.description: For cost assumptions: Price per unit. For productivity: Output per unit.

name: Asset
description: Plant/equipment master. Engineers type Asset ID on dailylog; tool fuzzy-matches when catalog rows exist.

subContractorId.title: Sub Contractor Id
subContractorId.description: Optional cross-reference to the SubContractor entity operating, renting, or otherwise responsible for this asset. Not a hierarchy parent — SubContractor is standalone.

name: Material
description: Catalog material master. Stock lives on currentStock/reservedQuantity. WhatsApp issue/procure/transaction children parent here.

location.description: Physical location/address of the store or project site.

storeName.description: Store name where the material is stocked (catalog field on Material â€” no Store entity).

reservedQuantity.description: WhatsApp extension: quantity reserved pending dispatch/delivery.

name: SubContractor
description: Optional subcontractor registry cross-referenced from EDL/Asset.

type.title: Type
type.description: Roles this subcontractor fulfills: workforce = supplies labour (subContractorId on EDL), material = supplies materials (vendor in Procurement Request), logistics = handles transport.

projectId.title: projectId
projectId.description: Project this subcontractor is engaged on.

name: BOQ
description: Bill of Quantities header. Child of Project; parent of Activity.

boqCode.description: BOQ code supervisors type on Correct (e.g. BOQ-01).

projectId.description: Parent Project business id (also stored as hierarchy parentId).

name: Activity
description: Work breakdown activity. Child of BOQ; parent of Supervisor Update.

boqId.description: Parent BOQ business id (also stored as hierarchy parentId).

activityCode.description: Activity code supervisors type on Correct (e.g. ACT-EXCAVATION).

name: Plan
description: Plan

projectId.title: Project Id
projectId.description: Informational grandparent (Project) reference — not the hierarchy parentId.

name: Supervisor Update
description: Catalog supervisor_update (child of Activity). Created on logsummary Correct.

name: Engineering Daily Logs
description: Catalog EDL (child of Asset) extended with WhatsApp DPR workflow fields.

status.description: Catalog lifecycle. processing = draft or awaiting supervisor; approved / rejected are terminal.

projectId.description: Project id resolved from the asset at submission time.

employeeId.description: Engineer employee id (business id) at submission time.

supervisorPhone.description: WhatsApp routing helper; resolved from employee match.

supervisorEmployeeId.description: Matched supervisor employee id for routing.

name: Material Procurement Request
description: Catalog MPR (child of Material) with WhatsApp RFQ/vendor/dispatch fields retained.

cost.description: Selected quotation cost when a vendor is chosen.

store.description: Link to the account's active store (from store-issue package).

status.description: Lifecycle status including quotation, dispatch, and delivery.

purpose.description: Business purpose of the procurement request.

loadedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the vendor marked Loaded.

materials.description: Line items in the RFQ, each with its own quotations[].

retryFlag.description: True while a re-negotiation quotation round is active.

driverName.description: Driver name provided by the selected vendor.

vendorList.description: Vendors invited to quote (phone + language + template parameters).

deliveredAt.description: ISO timestamp when Store Head tapped Received.

driverPhone.description: Driver phone provided by the selected vendor.

requestedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the request was submitted.

totalDistance.description: Distance in km between loading and unloading pincodes when calculable.

vehicleNumber.description: Vehicle number provided by the selected vendor.

materialEntityId.description: Parent material entity id for first line / primary material.

unloadingAddress.description: Delivery / unloading address. Defaults from active store location when blank at create.

selectedTransporter.description: Display name of the selected vendor.

transportersDetails.description: Runtime vendor quotation rollup used by comparison list tools.

deliveryFailureReason.description: Optional note when Store Head taps Not Received.

name: Material Issue Request
description: Catalog MIR (child of Material) extended with WhatsApp store/dispatch workflow fields.

storeName.description: Display name of the store (from Material.storeName at request time).

supervisor.description: Catalog string; WhatsApp may use Store Head name.

projectId.title: projectId
projectId.description: Project this issue request belongs to.

name: Material Transaction
description: Catalog material_transaction (child of Material). Replaces store-transaction for WhatsApp ledger writes.

name: Logistics
description: Logistics

materialIssueRequestId.title: Material Issue Request Id
materialIssueRequestId.description: Optional cross-reference to a Material Issue Request — not a hierarchy parent.

materialProcurementRequestId.title: Material Procurement Request Id
materialProcurementRequestId.description: Optional cross-reference to a Material Procurement Request — not a hierarchy parent.

name: Store Transaction
description: Ledger row for every inflow or outflow against a store-inventory row. Parent is always the inventory entity. materialRequestId is a cross-reference, not a hierarchy parent.

requestor.description: Name of the person who requested the material.

transactionType.description: INFLOW for receipts, OUTFLOW for issues / deliveries.

materialRequestId.description: Cross-reference to the originating material-request entity id.

name: Store Inventory
description: One inventory row per material per store. availableQuantity = quantity - reservedQuantity is computed in tool code and never stored.

unit.description: Unit of measure (bag, MT, cum, Nos, litre, etc.).

material.description: Material name from the shared materials enum.

quantity.description: On-hand quantity including any reserved amount.

reservedQuantity.description: Quantity reserved for in-flight approved requests that are not yet delivered.

name: Daily Log Summary
description: End-of-day rollup of engineers DPRs plus same-day material issue requests for one supervisor. Confirm accepts Work Done + Materials as-is. Link BOQ asks for BOQ/Activity, shows a preview, then Confirm stores supervisor_update under Activity.

boqId.description: Resolved BOQ business id after Correct.

logIds.description: Entity ids of the daily-log rows included in this summary.

status.description: PENDING_CONFIRM when dispatched; AWAITING_CORRECTION after Link BOQ; PENDING_LINK_CONFIRM after BOQ/Activity form preview; then CONFIRMED or CORRECTED.

boqCode.description: BOQ code typed / matched on Correct.

entries.description: One row per included daily log, used to rebuild the human-readable summary.

projectId.description: Informational Project id from BOQ/Activity ancestry.

activityId.description: Resolved Activity business id after Correct.

supervisor.description: The supervisor who owns this team summary.

pendingLink.description: Draft BOQ/Activity link payload awaiting final Confirm (PENDING_LINK_CONFIRM).

summaryDate.description: The calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD, IST) this summary covers.

summaryText.description: Built rollup of Work Done lines plus Materials Requested for the day. Used as confirmedWorkDone when the supervisor clicks Confirm.

activityCode.description: Activity code typed / matched on Correct.

activityEntityId.description: Resolved Activity entity id (parent of supervisor-update).

confirmedWorkDone.description: Final recorded summary text after Confirm (copy of summaryText) or Correct (supervisor Work Done). Includes Work Done context.

confirmedMaterials.description: Snapshot of materialsRequested stored when the supervisor confirms.

materialsRequested.description: Same-day material_issue_request line items included in the summary (no procurement).

materialsSummaryText.description: Human-readable materials totals and details for the summary date.

supervisorUpdateEntityId.description: Entity id of the supervisor-update row created on Correct.

name: Store
description: A project store / warehouse. Exactly one active store is expected per account for the material request flow. Store Head contact is denormalised on the entity for messaging.

isActive.description: Only active stores are considered when resolving the default store for a request.

location.description: Physical location or site name of the store.

storeCode.description: Short unique code for the store (e.g. STORE-01).

storeHead.description: Denormalised Store Head contact used for WhatsApp messaging.

name: Material Request
description: WhatsApp material issue request flowing from requester through Store Head and Dispatch Head to delivery confirmation. Holds the full workflow state.

unit.description: Unit of measure copied from the inventory row.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the material request.

purpose.description: Optional purpose / activity for the request.

material.description: Resolved material name from the shared enum.

requiredDate.description: Optional required-by date as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty string when not provided.

failureReason.description: Reason typed by requester on Not Received.

rejectionReason.description: Reason typed by Store Head on Reject.

inventoryEntityId.description: Entity id of the store-inventory row used for this request.

availableAtRequest.description: Snapshot of available quantity at validate time.

name: Daily Log
description: One Daily Progress Report (DPR) submitted by an engineer over WhatsApp and approved or rejected by a supervisor. Cross-references Asset / Activity when catalog match succeeds.

unit.description: Optional unit of work (e.g. cum, m, MT).

shift.description: Optional shift: shift-single | shift-Morning | shift-Evening (or free text).

status.description: Lifecycle status. DRAFT when the engineer has submitted but not yet confirmed, PENDING_APPROVAL once sent to the supervisor, then APPROVED, REJECTED or CANCELLED.

assetId.description: Asset identifier the work was done on, as typed by the engineer and upper-cased. Prefer matching against asset catalog when present.

logDate.description: The date the work was performed, normalised to YYYY-MM-DD in a code node. Never normalised by the LLM.

activity.description: Optional activity display name. Empty string when the engineer did not supply one.

name.description: Engineer's name, taken from employee context.

employeeId.description: Internal Employee id of the submitting engineer.

phoneNumber.description: Engineer's WhatsApp number, used to send acknowledgments and decision notifications.

engineer.description: The employee who submitted the daily log.

manpower.description: Optional engineer-reported worker counts; supervisor can override on Correct.

workDone.description: Free-text description of the work completed during the day.

decidedAt.description: When the supervisor approved or rejected the log.

activityId.description: Optional activity code / id typed by the engineer (informational xref).

name.description: Supervisor's name as stored in the employee record, not as typed by the engineer.

employeeId.description: Internal Employee id of the matched supervisor.

matchScore.description: fuzzball token_set_ratio score of the name match, 0-100.

phoneNumber.description: Supervisor's WhatsApp number. The approval template is sent here and the button clicker is authorised against it.

requestedName.description: The raw supervisor name the engineer typed, kept for audit of the fuzzy match.

supervisor.description: The supervisor resolved by fuzzy-matching the name the engineer typed against active employees whose designation is Supervisor.

cancelledAt.description: When the engineer cancelled the log at the confirmation step.

submittedAt.description: When the engineer submitted the details and the DRAFT was created.

assetEntityId.description: Resolved asset entity id when Asset ID matched the asset catalog; empty when free-text only.

odometerUsage.description: closingOdometer minus openingOdometer. Computed once in a code node and stored, never recomputed and never computed by the LLM.

subcontractor.description: Optional subcontractor name. Empty string when the engineer did not supply one.

decidedByPhone.description: Phone number of the person who clicked Approve or Reject, recorded for audit.

closingOdometer.description: Odometer reading at the end of the day. Must be greater than or equal to openingOdometer.

openingOdometer.description: Odometer reading at the start of the day, exactly as the engineer reported it.

subContractorId.description: Optional subcontractor id typed by the engineer (informational xref).

sentForApprovalAt.description: When the log moved to PENDING_APPROVAL and the supervisor was notified.
